title: agentarch waivers
description: Time-boxed, owned exceptions. Every field is required because an exception with no owner is nobody's problem to close, and one with no expiry is a quiet amendment to the standard.

control.description: The same closed vocabulary as control.schema.json and agent.manifest.schema.json. A looser pattern here accepts a waiver against a control type that cannot exist, which reports as a waived exception and suppresses nothing.

agent.description: Omit to apply to every agent in the project. An implementation should say so when reporting it, because a project-wide waiver is easy to record and easy to forget.

reason.description: Why this is being accepted. 'Temporary' is not a reason; what makes it acceptable until the expiry is.

owner.description: The person who will close it. Not a team — a team does not remember.

until.description: YYYY-MM-DD, in the future, at most 90 days out. Expiry produces exit 5 rather than the failure quietly reappearing, so the decision reaches the person who took it.
